description: List the windows a Book It business accepts booking requests for, by date in the business's time zone, after its minimum notice and without its days off, for up to 14 days at a time. Each window has a window_id for request_booking. A window is when the business says it can take work, not a confirmed slot.

business_id.description: The business_id exactly as find_provider returned it, such as "juniper-ridge-roofing".

days.description: How many days to show, 1 to 14. Defaults to 7.

from_date.description: First date to show, YYYY-MM-DD, in the business's time zone. Defaults to today there.

name: check_availability
title: Check request windows
